items.title: Google publishes safety write-up for Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary_en: A post on developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly says the model resists harmful requests better than earlier models. It reports prompt-injection attack success cut to 0.7% on one benchmark.
items.notes: Page fetch failed (DNS error). Details from a web-search summary; date and the 0.7% figure not verified on the page. Benchmark not identified. The Gemini 4 Argon launch post was not located.

items.title: On-device AI scam detection built with GovTech Singapore
items.summary_en: DeepMind describes an on-device, fine-tuned Gemma model built with Singapore's MDDI/GovTech to catch conversational scams in private chats.

items.title: DeepMind and Google Cloud offer European researchers frontier models and compute
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud are giving up to 200 European researchers access to frontier models plus about $3 million in compute credits for scientific discovery.

items.title: SynthID Detector expanded to everyone in English
items.summary_en: Google expanded the SynthID Detector for identifying AI-generated content to all users in English. The search summary also says TIME listed SynthID among its Best Inventions of 2026.

items.summary_en: A DeepMind post covers using Google Antigravity to search for new antimicrobial peptides. It also introduces a 3D structure viewer.
